framework.north_star: Can a real same-sample or matched-specimen nickelate packet supply P_oe + B_min before superconducting-output reveal, strongly enough to kill or preserve R_oe?
framework.scope_guard: This is not a universal theorem. The claim is restricted to current literature assembly and near-term matched-specimen designs that do not impose a new sealed, same-specimen metrology campaign.
standard_for_identification: P_oe must be estimated from normal-state odd/even bilayer susceptibility with raw S_channel_to_chi_unit calibration retained.
B_min must be measured by covariates that do not reuse the same qz, c-axis, pressure-path, matrix-element, or superconducting-output information that generates P_oe.
The residual call must be made before Tc, zero resistance, Meissner, diamagnetism, gap, spin resonance, critical-current, or output-trained labels are revealed.
Rows must be numerous enough for held-out residual testing rather than post-hoc alignment of a few famous samples.
evidence_base: Allowed plan files state that no complete same-sample P_oe + B_min packet was found at startup.
Seed literature supports individual components: RIXS/magnetic excitations, even/odd theory, pressure/structure, oxygen/ligand-hole, and optical baselines.

paper-search-mcp Round 1 found additional pressure/oxygen/structure results and reviews emphasizing reproducibility, oxygen content, sample quality, structural transitions, and high-pressure measurement difficulty.

findings.finding: P_oe and qz/c-axis B_min are not cleanly separable when assembled from existing probes.
findings.basis: Odd/even bilayer susceptibility requires qz, polarization, form-factor, and interlayer response extraction. The proposed B_min covariates include ordinary c-axis coherence, lattice geometry, dz2/rare-earth/ligand-hole/self-doping proxies, and structural phase, which are exactly the latent variables that shape the qz-dependent spectral weight and matrix elements.
findings.implication: A residual after subtracting B_min can be manufactured by choosing which c-axis information is assigned to P_oe versus baseline. The denominator is not independent of the numerator.

findings.finding: Pressure path, oxygen content, structural phase, and sample quality are treatment variables, not nuisance labels.
findings.basis: Recent La3Ni2O7 work links superconductivity and normal-state behavior to pressure, apical oxygen vacancies, structural transition, oxygen content windows, phase coexistence, and measurement reliability under high pressure.
findings.implication: Matched specimens from different pressure cells, batches, growth runs, oxygen histories, or probes do not define exchangeable rows for crossfit. Matching can hide rather than remove confounding.

findings.finding: S_channel_to_chi_unit and matrix-element calibration can create the residual that R_oe would interpret.
findings.basis: RIXS-like channel intensities require polarization, resonance, self-absorption, geometry, form-factor, and normalization choices before they become chi_odd or chi_even. These choices are coupled to orbital character, qz, pressure environment, and sample thickness/quality.
findings.implication: Unless raw counts, monitor normalization, geometry, energy resolution, polarization leakage, and uncertainty propagation are frozen before output reveal, the residual is calibration-contingent.

findings.basis: The relevant rows would need same-sample or tightly matched P_oe, oxygen/structure/orbital/disorder/c-axis baselines, pressure/thermal path, and sealed output labels. Current literature is fragmented across probes and specimens, with no found complete packet.
findings.implication: With N near the number of laboratories/samples rather than the number of independent blinded rows, held-out residuals are dominated by lab, batch, instrument, and pressure-cell effects.

findings.finding: Matched-specimen designs fail unless they match hidden preparation variables more tightly than current reporting usually allows.
findings.basis: Oxygen stoichiometry, phase admixture, strain, pressure medium, contact geometry, sample damage, and crystallinity can all move the same observables used in P_oe and B_min.
findings.implication: A matched row assembled from specimen A for RIXS, specimen B for optical transport, specimen C for high-pressure structure, and specimen D for superconducting output is not a row; it is a literature montage.

findings.finding: The packet may be experimentally possible, but only as a new sealed campaign.
findings.basis: The component measurements are plausible in principle, but the independence, raw calibration, pressure path logging, oxygen/structure characterization, and output blinding must be co-designed.
findings.implication: B does not prove impossibility of the physics. It blocks the claim that current or loosely matched literature can kill or preserve R_oe.

nonidentifiability_argument.short_form: The same latent variables generate both P_oe and B_min, and current measurements do not provide an independent instrument that perturbs or observes one without the other.
latent_variables: oxygen stoichiometry and apical vacancy configuration
La3Ni2O7 versus La4Ni3O10 or other RP phase admixture
dz2, rare-earth 5d, ligand-hole, and self-doping balance
sample damage, strain, thickness, mosaicity, and disorder
RIXS resonance, polarization, self-absorption, and normalization
identification_failure: P_oe is inferred from qz/polarization/form-factor-resolved spectral response.
B_min asks to regress out qz/c-axis/orbital/structure/oxygen/disorder/pressure baselines.
Those baselines are not pre-treatment covariates independent of P_oe; they are part of the same measurement-generating mechanism.
Therefore residual R_oe is underdetermined: the same dataset can support a large residual, no residual, or a sign-flipped residual depending on calibration and baseline allocation.
Crossfit does not solve this if folds split a small set of batch-correlated specimens rather than independent blinded samples.
nonidentifiability_argument.minimal_counterfactual_needed: A valid design needs at least one independent axis that changes B_min without changing P_oe calibration, or changes P_oe while holding B_min fixed, under sealed output labels. Current literature does not provide this counterfactual.

why_literature拼接_fails: Matched specimens do not preserve oxygen, pressure path, structural phase fraction, or damage history.
Raw S_channel_to_chi_unit calibration and censoring floors are usually not available in a reusable form.
Superconducting-output labels are often already known because the literature selected samples for the superconductivity question.
The number of complete blinded rows is effectively zero in the startup state.
what_new_experiment_would_require: Pre-registered normal-state measurement order before any superconducting-output reveal.
Same crystal or diced sister pieces with shared growth, oxygenation, and pressure/thermal logs.
In situ or immediately paired structure/oxygen/orbital/disorder/c-axis baselines under the same pressure path.
Raw RIXS or neutron channel counts with full geometry, polarization, monitor normalization, resolution, and matrix-element uncertainty.
Independent blind custodian for Tc, zero resistance, Meissner, diamagnetism, gap, spin resonance, and related labels.
Enough rows across pressure, oxygen, and batch axes to permit true held-out residual testing.

fatal_missing_fields.reason: Need a specimen genealogy linking growth batch, oxygenation, cutting, pressure cell, probe sequence, and output reveal status.
Need pressure medium, loading/unloading path, hydrostaticity, pressure gradients, dwell time, thermal cycling, and damage markers.
Need quantitative stoichiometry and apical vacancy configuration, not only nominal La3Ni2O7-delta labels.
Need orthorhombic/tetragonal/hidden/RP-intergrowth fractions at the actual pressure and temperature of P_oe and B_min.
Need raw counts, normalization, polarization leakage, geometry, self-absorption, resolution, resonance condition, and covariance to avoid calibration-made residuals.
Need a pre-frozen floor and censoring rule for weak/ambiguous odd-even denominators.
Need an independent baseline that is not derived from the same qz dependence used to define P_oe.
Need proof that Tc, zero resistance, Meissner, diamagnetism, gap, spin resonance, and critical-current information was unavailable before residual call.
Need rows where batch, lab, instrument, and probe sequence do not alias with P_oe or B_min.
Need a declared missingness model before seeing whether residuals align with superconducting output.

contamination_paths.description: qz-resolved odd/even intensity and c-axis coherence baselines share interlayer hopping, lattice geometry, dz2 weight, and pressure-induced structural changes.
Pressure path changes structure, defects, hydrostaticity, transport contacts, spectral response, and superconducting output at once.
Oxygen vacancies and ligand holes affect orbital filling, phase stability, scattering/disorder, superfluid density, and the normal-state spectral channels.
La3Ni2O7, La4Ni3O10, hidden phases, or orthorhombic/tetragonal fractions can masquerade as both bilayer odd-even physics and baseline quality.
Polarization, resonance energy, self-absorption, form-factor, sample orientation, and geometry can shift chi_odd/chi_even and also track structural/orbital baselines.
Crystals selected for strong spectral signal, clean transport, or high Tc may differ systematically in disorder, oxygenation, phase purity, and damage tolerance.
RIXS, optical, structural, transport, and magnetization data often come from different labs and samples, making instrument identity a proxy for the target covariate.
Published superconducting samples are usually already labeled by transport or magnetic output, so covariate choices can be unconsciously tuned to known success/failure.

what_would_defeat_this_B_argument: A same-crystal or genuinely sister-specimen dataset with pre-output P_oe, full B_min, raw calibration, and pressure/oxygen/phase logs.
A frozen analysis plan proving that qz/c-axis baselines used in B_min are measured independently of the P_oe extraction channel.
Blind residual calls made before any superconducting-output reveal.
Held-out rows spanning at least batch, pressure path, oxygen state, and structural phase, with folds split by batch/lab rather than by repeated measurements of the same object.
Negative controls showing that residuals do not appear when odd/even labels, qz channels, or output labels are permuted under the same calibration pipeline.
Sensitivity analysis showing R_oe sign and magnitude survive plausible matrix-element and denominator-floor perturbations.
falsifier_for_B.minimum_practical_threshold: B should concede PACKET_FEASIBLE_NEAR_FUTURE if a sealed campaign can produce at least several independent same-sample/sister-specimen rows with raw calibration, independent B_min, and blinded output labels. B should concede PACKET_FEASIBLE_NOW only if such rows already exist in accessible data, which this round did not find.

claims.claim: Current literature supports the existence of relevant measurement components, not a complete identifiable P_oe + B_min packet.
A literature-assembled packet is non-identifiable because P_oe and qz/c-axis/orbital/pressure/structure baselines share the same latent causes and calibration machinery.
Matched-specimen assembly is not enough unless growth, oxygen, pressure path, phase fraction, instrument, and output blinding are controlled as part of one protocol.
Small-N crossfit cannot rescue the packet when rows are batch/lab/probe-correlated and output labels are already known.
The route is not universally impossible; it requires a new sealed same-sample or tightly sistered-specimen experiment.
R_oe remains protocol-only for this packet until the new experiment or an already complete hidden dataset is identified.

inspector_check.A_independence: Did not read current-CphiPacket/A or any A output. Only top-level directory names were listed while checking that B exists.
inspector_check.universal_theorem_guard: The argument is explicitly bounded to current literature assembly and ordinary near-term matched-specimen designs; it allows a new sealed experiment to falsify B.
inspector_check.main_residual_risk: Some cited mcp search results are metadata/abstract-level, not full-paper extractions; this is acceptable for Round 1 B because the claim is about packet non-existence and coupling risks, not detailed numerical reproduction.
inspector_check.decision_target_mapping: Closest official plan label: PACKET_NONIDENTIFIABLE. More precise B label: PACKET_NONIDENTIFIABLE_FROM_CURRENT_LITERATURE; near-future only with new sealed experiment.
